en.text: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
You are the most excellent of the sons of men. has anointed your lips, has blessed you forever.
Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.

zhSimplified.text: 大能者啊，愿你腰间佩刀，

zhTraditional.text: 大能者啊，願你腰間佩刀，

en.text: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. your right hand display awesome deeds.

zhSimplified.text: 为真理、谦卑、公义赫然坐车前往，无不得胜；

zhTraditional.text: 為真理、謙卑、公義赫然坐車前往，無不得勝；

en.text: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

zhSimplified.text: 你的箭锋快，射中王敌之心；

zhTraditional.text: 你的箭鋒快，射中王敵之心；

en.text: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，你的宝座是永永远远的；

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，你的寶座是永永遠遠的；

en.text: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

zhSimplified.text: 你的衣服都有没药、沉香、肉桂；

zhTraditional.text: 你的衣服都有沒藥、沉香、肉桂；

en.text: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

zhSimplified.text: 有君王的女儿在你尊贵妇女之中； 金饰站在你右边。

zhTraditional.text: 有君王的女兒在你尊貴婦女之中； 金飾站在你右邊。

en.text: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. your own people, and also your father’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 女子啊，你要听，要想，要侧耳而听！

zhTraditional.text: 女子啊，你要聽，要想，要側耳而聽！

en.text: So the king will desire your beauty, him, for he is your lord.
The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.
The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

zhSimplified.text: 王女在里极其荣华； 绣的。

zhTraditional.text: 王女在裏極其榮華； 繡的。

en.text: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

zhSimplified.text: 她要穿锦绣的衣服，被引到王前；

zhTraditional.text: 她要穿錦繡的衣服，被引到王前；

en.text: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

zhSimplified.text: 她们要欢喜快乐被引导；

zhTraditional.text: 她們要歡喜快樂被引導；

en.text: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 你的子孙要接续你的列祖；

zhTraditional.text: 你的子孫要接續你的列祖；

en.text: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

zhSimplified.text: 我必叫你的名被万代记念，

zhTraditional.text: 我必叫你的名被萬代記念，
